evidence.note: fullReasonForFile if-chains isExactFile(DOCGEN_LOCAL_FULL_INPUT_FILES) then hasPrefix(DOCGEN_LOCAL_FULL_INPUT_PREFIXES) and never handles combined-true. The exact list is root filenames (bun.lock, package.json, tsconfig*.json) while the prefixes are packages/tooling/tool/docgen/ and commands/Docgen/, so both-true is excluded.

notes: Changed-path kind exact-global-file|docgen-tooling-prefix|other projected from one filePath.

disqualifier.note: Three matching strategies over caller-supplied lists. isPackageLocalDocgenInput ORs exact membership with prefix-AND-extension; combined prefix+extension is the intended src/*.ts hit, so the combos are independently meaningful rather than a masked union.

docgenLaneModeForChangedPaths is a priority ternary (global then relevant then none) over free combinations. bun.lock is global-only; apps/foo/src/x.ts is relevant-only; packages/tooling/tool/docgen/src/Core.ts is both; LICENSE is neither. Combined-true is a legal path, not a masked union.
S.is of three distinct tagged-union members used to partition CiLaneTimingWindowRow. The union already carries population; the guards are not sibling stored flags of one record.

Layered identity predicates over different field subsets of one SourceIdentity pair. sameSourceIdentity is except-mtime plus mtime equality; sameDeviceAndInode is a weaker device+inode probe that can hold when mode/size/type differ. Combined-true is the full-identity hit, not a masked union of exclusive kinds.

Independent path-family probes used at different call sites (gitkeep rows vs reflection validation). Combined-true is unused because the suffixes are disjoint, but readers never match the pair as exclusive kinds of one path.
